meta.title: Palsya
meta.description: A structured daily programme built by facial rehabilitation specialists — taping, exercises, and eye care matched to the stage your recovery is actually in.

hero.title: One side of your face stopped moving. Here is what to do next.
hero.lead: A structured daily programme built by facial rehabilitation specialists — taping, exercises, and eye care matched to the stage your recovery is actually in. With scans that show you change you cannot see in the mirror.

problem.title: Most people are sent home with a leaflet
problem.lead: A photocopied sheet of exercises, no idea which ones apply to you this week, no way to tell whether anything is working, and four months to wait before your next appointment. That gap is where Palsya lives.

rightWork.title: The right work for this week
rightWork.body: Forcing a big smile helps in week six and holds you back in week two. Your programme is matched to the stage your recovery is in and changes as that changes.

proof.title: Proof you are not imagining it
proof.body: A weekly scan measures the geometry of your face against your own baseline. During the plateau weeks — and there are plateau weeks — this is what tells you the truth.

person.title: A person who has seen this before
person.body: Video consultations with facial rehabilitation specialists. Most people are doing one or two things wrong; a clinician usually spots it in the first ten minutes.

stages.title: Five stages, because week two and month five are not the same problem

assessment.title: Answer the assessment
assessment.body: Sixteen questions about what moves, what does not, and what daily life is like right now. It also checks that we are the right fit — and tells you plainly if we are not.

plan.title: Get your stage and your plan
plan.body: You are placed in one of five stages with the reasoning shown. If your answers are unusual, a clinician reviews the placement before you start.

daily.title: Ten to twenty minutes a day
daily.body: Taping, exercises, and the daily routine, guided step by step. A scan once a week. That is the whole commitment.

ethics.title: A short list, and we mean it

predictions.title: No predictions
predictions.body: We will never tell you when your face will recover or how much of it will come back. Nobody can know that from your data, and being told a number you then miss does real harm.

guilt.title: No guilt for missed days
guilt.body: Miss a week and nothing resets, nothing is lost, and no notification tells you that you have broken anything. You open the app and do today's session.

badges.title: No badges, points, or streaks
badges.body: You are recovering from a nerve injury, not playing a game. Progress is shown as measurements and as things you can newly do.

comparing.title: No comparing you with other patients
comparing.body: Your scans are compared with your own baseline and nothing else. A leaderboard of faces would be grotesque.

pricing.title: Three months, because that is how long change takes
pricing.lead: Seven days free. You are not charged until day 8, and nothing is pre-selected for you.
pricing.after: After your first three months: {extension} a month, or stop. Extra consultations {consult}. Referred by a clinician? That is {discount, number, percent} off — enter their code at checkout.

guides.title: The guides we wish we had been handed

finalCta.title: Start today, decide on day seven
finalCta.lead: No card, no charge until day 8, and you can take your data with you if you leave.
